106 contributions

Excellent vegan food with a nice ambience
May 2016 • Couples
We have eaten here several times since it has opened. 

The food is delicious and full of flavour, without any of the bloating/oily feeling that can sometimes come after a large meal. The dishes are a good size, we usually get 3-4 dishes and steamed rice for 2 people (with large appetites). 

Our favourites are: claypot tofu, southern style fillet, the beef fillets in black pepper, banh xeo.

The service is prompt and friendly. We didn't know how to eat the Banh Xeo the first time we went there, and they promptly explained it to us. 

Great place for a nice meal!

Classy and good!
Mar 2016 • Couples
We were in Hanoi a couple weeks ago and I am not sure this place even existed then so I think it is pretty new! When searching for vegan and vegetarian meals on Google Maps this location did not come up. We only stumbled upon it after visiting the Vietnamese Women's Museum (cool place!) as it is right across the street. We were actually not sure the restaurant was there at first. There is a Loving Hut grocery store on the first floor and you go inside and up the elevator to get to the restaurant. It is a very upscale Loving Hut, probably the nicest I have ever seen. Our service was very good and very fast. Our food was also delicious. We will probably be back!
